name: reply-adapter
description: Executes the AI SDR Core operation contract against Reply.io: the reply CLI, API v3, the MCP server, authentication and scopes, and translation of Reply-specific errors. Replaceable — swap it for another provider's adapter without touching the core.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Reply.io from your agent — CLI, API v3 and MCP
interface.longDescription: Turns the vendor-neutral SDR operations into real Reply.io calls: which endpoint group serves which operation, the order composite work must run in, how to authenticate and scope an API key, and what Reply's errors actually mean. Requires a Reply.io account and the AI SDR Core pack.
